verses.text: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

verses.text: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

verses.text: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

verses.text: Now Elihu had waited to speak unto Job, because they were elder than he.

verses.text: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

verses.text: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; Wherefore I held back, and durst not show you mine opinion.

verses.text: I said, Days should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.

verses.text: But there is a spirit in man, And the breath of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

verses.text: It is not the great that are wise, Nor the aged that understand justice.

verses.text: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will show mine opinion.

verses.text: Behold, I waited for your words, I listened for your reasonings, Whilst ye searched out what to say.

verses.text: Yea, I attended unto you, And, behold, there was none that convinced Job, Or that answered his words, among you.

verses.text: Beware lest ye say, We have found wisdom; God may vanquish him, not man:

verses.text: For he hath not directed his words against me; Neither will I answer him with your speeches.
